snippet.title: CBT1 Official Trailer | Spot Zero
snippet.description:
Spot Zero CBT1 is almost here!
The ultimate anime gacha ARPG experience is coming soon. Don’t miss your chance to join the Closed Beta Test 1 (CBT1) and be among the first to play Spot Zero.

CBT1 time: April 15-21 8AM UTC
CBT1 full program: https://medium.com/@spotzero_official/spot-zero-cbt1-guidelines-enter-the-celestial-sea-47e208335d29

Pre-register now for a chance to get access!
🔗 https://spotzero.tartagames.com/

Join the Spot Zero community:
Twitter: https://twitter.com/SpotZeroGame
Discord: https://discord.gg/SpotZero
